name: Domoticz
tagline: A Home Automation System that lets you monitor and configure various devices like: Lights, Switches, various sensors/meters like Temperature, Rain, Wind, UV, Electra, Gas, Water and much more. Notifications/Alerts can be sent to any mobile device.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/domoticz:2023.2.20231129@sha256:db5939da7ee7979a2a29ac455f5bee6646d59ef32f3ea20a3be0d77667ef8428
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      WEBROOT: ''
      DBASE: ''
    ports:
      - target: 8080
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 6144
        published: 6144
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 1443
        published: 1443
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
